title: Estes looks back from the cockpit, Rosethorn 007
description: A helmeted man in the front seat turns in flight to smile back at the camera, visor down and boom mic at his lips, EMERGENCY EXIT stenciled on the yellow cockpit frame beside him; at the left edge the other seat is partly in view. "Just taking off on the flight line heading to Nui Ba Den." Larry first named the man Major Lewis. Looking again on 2026-09-12, when his son pointed out that there seemed to be a name on the helmet, he read it: "oh his last name is Estes, I was thinking his name was Lewis. I think he was National Guard and probably got called up. Lewis must be somebody else." The man looking back was not the one flying: "Usually the guy looking back is not flying the plane and he was talking to me." The pilot, he thinks, was Geutler, "possibly to the left of Estes." Larry remembers marathon days aboard Rosethorn 007 — once taking off at 4 a.m., refueling at Qui Nhơn (where he bought his camera at the PX), and returning at 11 at night, rain clouds pouring down across the country.
researchNotes: Two accounts, in the later of which Larry corrects the earlier. 2026-08-15 (giscus-vn-0016-c18032603.json): 'This is major Lewis. We are flying in Aircraft Rosethorn 007.' 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0016-c18415741.json and -c18415765.json): 'Location: Ton Son Nhut', taking off for Núi Bà Đen, and the name Estes read from the helmet. HOW THE NAME ARRIVED: his son told him it looked like there was a name on the helmet, and Larry read it off the photograph — so 'Estes' is his reading of the lettering, not a memory recovered unprompted. It agrees with the machine reading of the same visor lettering made in the 2026-08-09 survey and the 2026-08-15 magnification (research/people/major-lewis.md). Two readings of one inscription settle the lettering, not the wearer, since flight helmets were pooled and swapped; what Larry added after reading it (National Guard, called up, talking to him over his shoulder) is memory. His own first-person withdrawal, 'Lewis must be somebody else', removes the Major Lewis link from this frame, as 'This is not Stanton' did for VN-0026; Major Lewis stays a name he remembers without a photograph (data/people/major-lewis.json, issue #63). Captain Guegler is not linked: 'possibly' is Larry's hedge, and the seat at left is too little in frame to show anyone. The 2026-08-15 Rosethorn 007 attribution was not withdrawn and stands. Person record: data/people/estes.json; issue #155.
